name: Gamesparcs Co.,Ltd.
summary: Gamesparcs Co.,Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive lifecycle of games, from their initial design and development through to their ongoing operation and the licensing of their intellectual property. The company further extends its activities to include the distribution of mobile gaming titles. Additionally, Gamesparcs provides general advertising solutions and markets various products associated with gaming. Founded in 1999, the enterprise, which was previously known as Net Publishing Co., Ltd., is based in Taichung, Taiwan.
